name: Family Table
tagline: One weekly plan the whole family will eat
about: Family Table plans dinners around real schedules, ages and tastes — one dish everyone eats, with tweaks for toddlers, teens and fussy grown-ups, plus kitchen jobs for the kids.
persona: You are a calm family-meal planner: you cook one dinner not three, respect kids' tastes without catering to them entirely, and give age-appropriate safety notes.

onboarding.title: Dinner, solved for everyone
onboarding.subtitle: Tell Family Table who's eating and what your evenings look like.
bullets: Weekly plans around clubs and late shifts
One dish, adapted for every age

profile.label: Hard no's & allergies
profile.placeholder: no nuts, Leo hates sauce touching

tools.title: Plan the week
tools.subtitle: Dinners around the calendar

inputs.label: This week's evenings
inputs.placeholder: Mon football 6pm, Wed late shift, Fri takeaway-ish

inputs.label: Use up / on offer
inputs.placeholder: half a cabbage, mince on offer

tools.prompt: Plan 7 family dinners for the profile around: {schedule}, using {use}. Table (Day | Dinner | Prep | Cook time | Kid tweak), a checklist shopping list grouped by aisle, and bullets on which nights to double-cook so the busy ones are covered.

tools.title: One dish, everyone eats
tools.subtitle: Adapt tonight's dinner for all ages

inputs.label: Who objects and why
inputs.placeholder: Ava is 2, Leo won't eat peppers

tools.prompt: Make {dish} work for the whole profile family given: {issue}. Steps for the base recipe, a table (Person | Their version | What changes) with a row for every family member, a callout on toddler food safety (salt, whole grapes, choking-size pieces) if a child under 4 is listed, and bullets of gentle ways to get a refused ingredient re-tried.

tools.title: Kids' kitchen jobs
tools.subtitle: Age-appropriate tasks for tonight
tools.prompt: For {dish}, assign kitchen jobs to each child in the profile by age: table (Child | Job | Why it's safe | Grown-up watches for), steps for the parent's cook order that fits those jobs in, and a callout on knife, hob and hot-pan rules by age.

tools.title: Stretch it
tools.subtitle: Unexpected guests or a second night
tools.prompt: Stretch {dish} to feed {more} more people, {when}: kv (extra ingredients to add, pan size, adjusted cook time), bullets of cheap bulkers that don't change the dish, and cards of 2 next-day meals from the extra (meta = reheat minutes) if 'Tomorrow too' was chosen.

tools.title: 5pm panic
tools.subtitle: Nothing planned, everyone's hungry

inputs.label: What's in the house
inputs.placeholder: eggs, wraps, cheese, tinned tomatoes, frozen veg

tools.prompt: Everyone is hungry in {mins} minutes and the house has: {have}. Cards of 3 dinners doable in that time (meta = minutes · which family members will eat it), steps for the best one starting with what to put on first, and a quote with one sentence to say to the kids to buy time.

disclaimer: Food-safety and choking notes are general guidance; follow your paediatrician's advice for babies and toddlers.
